translation: Because of marriage, I was demoted to guard Fangling, and then transferred to Daning Commandery. Carrying my family along the river, braving the steaming heat, from south to north, both remote and crude, I was infected by miasma, and six or seven in ten died; life and death were separated, and I could not ask Heaven. Relying on the canonical formulas that alone survived, whose spirit-work and marvelous use are indeed hard to describe, I then roused myself to edit and abridge, hoping for a corner of it. In all, I compiled some fifty or sixty schools of ancient formulas, and the newly written ones approached several thousand hundred volumes; I studied their general principles and verified their aims. In recent times, the monk Sengshen, Minister Cui, Hermit Sun, Zhang Wenzhong, Meng of Tongzhou, Xu Renze, Wu Sheng, and more than ten other schools all had compilations, circulating together in the age; beautiful they were, but not yet fully good. Why? Each excelled in its own style, contradicting one another in turn, with some having overlapping and mixed chapter titles, and some having complicated and overgrown discussions.
